notes: The italicized second *said* is added under rule 103: εἶπεν (s001) is already spent on t003 and the ὁ δέ clause is verbless, so no unspent token licenses it. The note preserves the defensible alternative of reading it as a discontinuous second realization of s001 under rule 15.
ὁ takes the bare pronoun *he* under rule 22, no participle following.
